issues.problem: A patient id that the directory does not know still opens a patient context. requestPatient loads the banner through loadBannerModel, which turns 'unknown patient' (undefined) into an error-state banner, and then always sends SelectPatient. So any well-formed `?patient=<anything>` makes the window hold a patient that does not exist. This fails visibly (error banner, signing blocked), but the window is in 'patient open' with a phantom id instead of showing the chooser or a not-found state. KA-044 (3) records only that an unmatched route has no not-found message; this case is not recorded.
issues.evidence: Headless Chrome on the Windows host, demo build served by vite preview: /demo/banner?patient=NOPE-1 stays at that address, shows section.hms-banner with the text 'Patient banner data unavailable … Kurdish name missing … Latin name missing', and shows no chooser. directory.ts: `loadBannerData: (patientId) => Promise.resolve(DEMO_FIXTURES.find(...)?.data)` returns undefined for an unknown id. patient-context-store.ts sends SelectPatient whatever the load returned.
issues.fix: Let the directory tell 'unknown patient' apart from 'data unavailable'. For an unknown id, do not send SelectPatient: restore the address and show the chooser, or show a not-found message once a catalogue key exists. Otherwise, record the behaviour in KA-044 or OQ-163 as a [P] choice for the CSO to confirm.

issues.problem: No automated test covers the mechanism that keeps the demo out of production bundles. The 'absent from the production route tree' check builds createAppRouteTree from the source file selected.ts (always null under Vitest) and tests isDemoBuild. The hms-demo-module resolveId plugin that actually swaps the module is not exported and not tested, and the bundle check (grep for SYN-PAT, demo/banner, user-synthetic-demo) was done by hand. A regression in the plugin, for example dropping the `!demo` guard, would pass every test. The only remaining defence is createSimulatedAuthenticator throwing at module load in PROD without the flag.
issues.evidence: vite.config.ts: demoModuleSwitch(demo) is a module-private function; DEMO_MODULE_FILES is exported but no test uses it (grep of apps/web/test finds no match). route-tree.test.ts: `const productionTree = (): AnyRoute => createAppRouteTree(productionDemoModule);` where productionDemoModule is imported from ../src/demo/selected.ts. Bundles built on the Windows host: the production bundle has 0 matches for SYN-PAT, demo/banner, user-synthetic-demo and iVBORw0KGgo; the demo bundle has 1, 2, 1 and 1. So the switch works today, but only a manual check shows it.
issues.fix: Export the plugin factory and unit-test that resolveId returns null for every importer when demo=false and maps selected.ts to index.ts only when demo=true. Better still, add a build-level check (an S7 or CI step that builds without the flag and fails if the bundle contains 'SYN-PAT' or '/demo/banner'), and list it with the demo-exclusion row of §9.

issues.problem: The §5 coverage test does not check one of the cases its own comment claims. The comment reads 'A governed label missing in some locale (shown with "Not translated"), and one with no label at all', but the only assertion looks for an allergy item whose labels object is empty (no label at all). Nothing checks that a fixture has a label present in some locales and missing in the user's locale, which is the §5 case 'a label missing in the user's locale'. The label-untranslated fixture does contain such a case (Codeine with en only; SYN-ISO-CONTACT with ckb only), but deleting it would not fail the test.
issues.evidence: demo-fixtures.test.ts: the comment is followed by a single `expect(some((m) => m.allergies.status === 'list' && m.allergies.items.some((item) => Object.keys(item.substance.labels).length === 0))).toBe(true);`. fixtures.ts line ~440: id 'label-untranslated' with concept('SYN-ALG-CODEINE', 'Codeine') and concept('SYN-ISO-CONTACT', undefined, 'بەرکەوتن (نموونە)').
issues.fix: Add an assertion that some fixture has a governed label with at least one locale present and at least one of en/ckb/ar missing, for example an allergy substance or an isolation precaution whose label keys are a non-empty proper subset of ['en','ckb','ar'].

issues.problem: An address request that is still loading is never cancelled when the address moves on. requestPatient awaits queryClient.query(...) and then sends SelectPatient without checking that the address still asks for that patient. Rule 2 starts a second request as soon as requestedId changes, even while inFlight is true. If the address changes from B to C while B is loading, B's SelectPatient still fires, so the confirmation can show B while the address says C, or C's refusal can restore the address to the context patient while B's confirmation is open. This cannot be seen in the demo, where loads resolve immediately, but it is the CTRL-0016-6 'address, banner and content name one patient' rule, and it becomes reachable once WP-0.4 brings a network directory.
issues.evidence: patient-context-store.ts requestPatient: `const banner = await queryClient.query(...); const result = send({ type: 'SelectPatient', patient: { patientId, banner }, user: sessionUser });` has no staleness check. use-patient-url-sync.ts rule 2: `if (requestedId !== handled.current) { handled.current = requestedId; inFlight.current = true; void store.requestPatient(requestedId)... }` has no guard for an earlier request still in flight and no generation token.
issues.fix: Give each request a generation counter or an AbortSignal. After the await, drop the result (no SelectPatient) if a newer request has started or the address no longer names that patient, and prune the cache for it. Alternatively, record the limitation in KA-044 for WP-0.4.

All six issues were real. Each is fixed below.

1. (major) Test name. In frontend/apps/web/test/route-tree.test.ts the describe block is now 'ArchTest:banner-present-on-every-clinical-route'. The JUnit report frontend/reports/junit/web.xml now shows test names like "ArchTest:banner-present-on-every-clinical-route > …". The file name already matched §9, so I did not rename it.

2. (minor) The development server had no demo. A `.env.development` file cannot be used because `.gitignore` ignores `.env.*` (lines 31-32), so the default is set in frontend/apps/web/vite.config.ts:
   - new exported `demoEnabled(command, env)`;
   - `vite build` gets the demo only when `VITE_HMS_DEMO` is exactly `1` (no change);
   - `vite dev` serves the demo unless `VITE_HMS_DEMO` is set to something other than `1`. The dev server builds no bundle, and simulated sign-in is already allowed outside PROD;
   - the header now lists `VITE_HMS_DEMO=0 … dev` for a dev server without the demo;
   - src/env.d.ts comment updated.
   So plan §5's `corepack pnpm --filter @hms/web dev` now serves /demo/banner as written.

3. (minor) An unknown patient opened a context.
   - src/patient/directory.ts: `loadBannerModel` now returns `BannerModel | null`. null means the directory resolved undefined (unknown patient). A directory that throws still gives an error-state banner with signing blocked, because the patient may exist.
   - src/patient/patient-queries.ts: the query type is now `BannerModel | null`.
   - src/patient/patient-context-store.ts: an unknown patient gets `{kind:'unknown-patient'}`, SelectPatient is never sent, and the cache is pruned.
   - src/patient/use-patient-url-sync.ts: the address is put back to the current patient. In an empty window that means no patient, so the chooser shows.

4. (minor) No automated test for the demo switch. In vite.config.ts `demoModuleSwitch` is now exported. New file frontend/apps/web/test/demo-build-exclusion.test.ts (node environment), describe 'demo-absent-from-production-bundle', 4 tests:
   - `demoEnabled` for build and serve;
   - the plugin resolves nothing when the demo is off;
   - the plugin maps only selected.ts (also with a ?query) to index.ts when the demo is on, and never an entry point;
   - two real Vite builds in memory (write:false), without and with the flag. The production JavaScript must contain none of 'SYN-PAT-', 'demo/banner', 'user-synthetic-demo' or 'iVBORw0KGgo'; the demo JavaScript must contain all four; both index.html files must carry the CSP. The test has a 120 s limit; the two builds take about 12.5 s on the Windows host.

5. (minor) The fixture test missed one §5 case. test/demo-fixtures.test.ts now also checks that some fixture has a governed label present in at least one, but not all, of en/ckb/ar. It looks at allergy substance, reaction and severity, isolation precautions and the code-status concept, and keeps the no-label check.

6. (minor) A loading request was never cancelled.
   - Store: each request gets a number. `requestPatient` overtakes any earlier request. A result that comes back after being overtaken sends nothing, returns `{kind:'superseded'}` and pruned from the cache. A query cancelled because it was removed from the cache is also treated as superseded.
   - New `cancelPatientRequest()`. The cache keeps the query of the request still loading when another transition prunes the cache.
   - `requestPatient` now returns a `PatientRequestOutcome` union instead of `TransitionResult | undefined`. Its only callers are the hook and the tests.
   - Hook: new rule 5. A request still loading is cancelled when the address stops naming its patient, or when the context changes without it. Each request has its own number, so a stale settle is ignored.
